<message>
My girlfriend broke up with me. Although I know it's the best outcome for both of us, I still can't let it go.
</message>

<passage>
What do you desire? To live on? Or is it to feel or to desire? To grow and to decay again? To speak or think? Which of all these seems worthy to be desired? And, if each and all of them is despicable, proceed to the last that remains, to follow reason and God. Now, it is repugnant to reverence for reason and for God to grieve at the loss by death of these other despicable things.
</passage>

output.reason: Offers perspective on valuing reason over transient feelings, aiding acceptance.
